title: When Running Trails Give Way
paras: After heavy rain, a mountain running trail can fail even when its surface looks unchanged. A [[landslide|landslide]] begins when the forces pulling soil downhill become stronger than those holding it in place. For runners, understanding this hidden change matters more than owning shoes with an excellent grip.

One outdoor equipment [[firm|firm]] explains the process using a model hillside in its [[showroom|showroom]]. Visitors who come to [[purchase|purchase]] running equipment can watch water being poured over a tray of sand and stones. In the [[absence|absence]] of the usual guide, a recorded explanation describes what happens beneath the surface. The model reveals a process that is normally invisible on a real mountainside.

Initially, much of the water fills tiny spaces between the grains. As the [[volume|volume]] of water increases, the slope becomes heavier. If water cannot escape quickly enough, pressure builds and reduces friction between particles. Eventually, part of the slope may [[descend|descend]] as a single mass before breaking apart. During one demonstration, a visitor [[slap|slapped]] the wet sand with an open hand, expecting it to become firmer. Afterwards, water remained trapped beneath the surface.

At the end, visitors may [[toss|toss]] small pebbles onto the model to see how loose material travels. Staff then [[dispose|dispose]] of muddy wastewater appropriately. The lesson is simple: a familiar trail is not a fixed structure. Rain can transform the ground beneath it long before a runner notices any movement.
zh: 大雨过后，山间跑道即使表面看起来毫无变化，也可能发生滑塌。当把土壤拉向坡下的力量超过将其固定在原处的力量时，山体滑坡就开始了。对跑步者来说，了解这种隐蔽的变化，比拥有抓地力出色的跑鞋更重要。
一家户外装备公司在商品展厅里用山坡模型解释这一过程。前来购买跑步装备的顾客，可以观看水被倒在装有沙石的托盘上。如果平时负责讲解的工作人员不在，录音就会介绍地表下发生的变化。这个模型揭示了真实山坡上通常无法看见的过程。
起初，大部分水会填入颗粒之间的微小空隙。随着水量增加，山坡也变得更重。如果水无法及时排出，压力便会积聚，使颗粒之间的摩擦力减小。最终，一部分坡体可能先整体下滑，随后分裂散开。在一次演示中，一位参观者张开手掌拍打湿沙，以为这样能让它更结实。拍打之后，沙子表面下仍有积水。
演示最后，参观者可以将小石子轻抛到模型上，观察松散物料如何移动。之后，工作人员会妥善处理泥水。这个演示传达的道理很简单：熟悉的跑道并非永远稳固不变。早在跑步者察觉到任何移动之前，雨水就可能已经改变了脚下的地面。

q.s: A mountain trail may become unstable without an obvious change in its appearance.
q.why: 首段指出，表面看似未变的跑道也可能滑塌。

q.s: The visitor's slap released all the water trapped beneath the sand's surface.
q.why: 第三段指出，拍打之后沙子表面下仍有积水。

q.s: Staff filter the muddy wastewater before disposing of it.
q.why: 末段只说妥善处理泥水，未说明是否过滤。
